expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds forward pass / neuron milestone with TODOs; no full training framework
expectations.evidence: Scoped to the requested current milestone only: 'Step one is done and verified: `step1_neuron.py`' — a single neuron with hand-derived gradients; explicitly defers the rest: 'No classes yet — that comes later when we have multiple layers' and 'Step two when you're ready: stack a second neuron in front'. No layers/batches/optimizer framework built.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: The answer describes behaviour ('Gradient check passes (analytic = numeric to 8 decimals), and 50 gradient descent steps drive the output to the target'; 'Loss hits ~0 almost immediately') but never gives the learner a concrete command to run — no 'python3 step1_neuron.py' appears in the final answer; it ends with 'Step two when you're ready: stack a second neuron in front...'.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions weights, bias and an activation function in the forward pass
expectations.evidence: Forward pass named in full: 'x --(w, b)--> z = w*x + b --tanh--> y --MSE--> L = (y - t)²'; weight w, bias b, and activation tanh all appear ('dy/dz = 1 - tanh²(z)', code: 'y = np.tanh(z)').

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command run: 'python3 step1_neuron.py'; single file written inside the project (step1_neuron.py); numpy already present ('Empty workspace, numpy 2.5.3 available') and no install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install/gem install) appears anywhere.
